mapper.insert: insert into salary(sal_no, user_no, sal_pymnt_date, sal_amount, sal_classify) SELECT (select nvl(max(S.sal_no),0)+1 from salary S) + ROWNUM , T.USER_NO , SYSDATE , T.salAmount , 2 FROM ( select u.user_no , se.position_no , SUM(nvl(to_number(substr(working_time,0,2)),0) * 10000) salAmount from tb_user u left outer join schedule s on(u.user_no = s.user_no) left outer join store_emp se on(se.user_no = u.user_no) left outer join store st on(st.store_no=se.store_no) where se.position_no in(6) and st.store_no=#{storeNo} and to_char(s.schdul_date,'YYYY-MM')=to_char(sysdate,'YYYY-MM') GROUP BY U.USER_NO, SE.POSITION_NO ) T
